activity.notes: At Halle, Cantor solved a uniqueness problem on trigonometric series in 1870, developed set theory and infinite cardinality in the 1870s and 1880s, and continued major set-theoretic publications during the 1890s. The 1897 end is a representative major-contribution boundary, not a claim of retirement or lifetime endpoint.
